git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add threshold gating to frai eval command

Adds a --threshold option to the frai eval CLI command and threshold support to the frai-core generateReport SDK function. Users can specify multiple thresholds (e.g., --threshold exact_match=0.9 --threshold toxicity=0.95) to gate CI jobs on metric quality.

- Exit code 1 if any threshold fails, 0 if all pass
- Report is written either way and includes pass/fail status
- Reports gain a "thresholds" field with metric, min, score, and passed for each threshold
- Markdown reports include a Thresholds section showing PASS/FAIL status
- CLI validates threshold format (metric=<0-1 number>) and metric existence before running evaluations
- Invalid thresholds cause exit 2 with informative error message
- Works with custom metrics passed to runEvaluations in the SDK
- Documentation updated in both CLI and core README files

Valid metrics for CLI: exact_match, toxicity, length_variance
EOF
)" --author "Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
